page.overview:
Who is Arburuk the Unbreakable?

is an Olog-hai in service of Sauron created for Critical Role One-Shot: Shadow of War – Part 1 and 2. is played by Laura Bailey.

Arburuk has very few abilities, all of which allow her to take more punishment and dish it out. As a burly Olog, she has an inborn Troll's Endurance that allows her to ignore some damage, similar to a Goliath.
